common: Paint TWO distinct full-body RUN keyframes side by side, ONE row TWO columns, same character camera scale. Reference1 locks elegant character identity, tall natural mature proportions, costume and exact heading. Reference2 shows the TWO REQUIRED ANATOMICAL POSES. ORANGE guide limbs mean RIGHT arm/leg; BLUE mean LEFT. Trace both limb poses but use natural costume colors, no guide colors or labels. Each character has exactly one signature device on ANATOMICAL RIGHT forearm; LEFT forearm plain sleeve/leather glove, never a second device. Both hands dark fingerless gloves. Clear separation, 20% transparent margins, whole head/hair/cloth/hands/boots visible. Painterly elegant detailing; opaque ivory clothing. No extra limbs, no duplicated pose, no backdrop ground shadow halo text. Actual alpha-transparent PNG and negative spaces. CRITICAL GAIT: second figure must EXCHANGE which anatomical thigh is in FRONT. Do not repeat identical leg overlap/boot silhouettes. Both sides of the gait are required.

phases: LEFT PANEL frame1: LEFT leg straight forward/down in ground contact, RIGHT knee flexed boot behind. RIGHT device arm bent FORWARD at chest, LEFT plain arm back. RIGHT PANEL frame5: RIGHT leg straight forward/down in ground contact, LEFT knee flexed boot behind. RIGHT device arm BACK behind hip, LEFT plain arm forward. They are opposite contact poses.

LEFT PANEL frame2: LEFT leg supports weight beneath hip; RIGHT knee rises forward and its lower leg folds backward. RIGHT device arm still forward. RIGHT PANEL frame6: RIGHT leg supports weight beneath hip; LEFT knee rises forward and lower leg folds backward. RIGHT device arm back, LEFT plain arm forward. Opposite compression/passing poses.

LEFT PANEL frame3: LEFT leg reaches behind pushing off; RIGHT knee drives forward high with boot folded underneath it. Arms pass low near the hips; RIGHT device arm forward-low. RIGHT PANEL frame7: RIGHT leg reaches behind pushing off; LEFT knee drives forward high with boot folded underneath. Arms pass low near hips; RIGHT device arm back-low. Opposite knee-passing poses, not contact poses.

LEFT PANEL frame4: AIRBORNE flight, RIGHT leg extends FORWARD, LEFT leg stretches BACK; RIGHT device arm swings BACK, LEFT plain arm FORWARD. RIGHT PANEL frame8: AIRBORNE flight, LEFT leg extends FORWARD, RIGHT leg stretches BACK; RIGHT device arm FORWARD, LEFT plain arm BACK. Opposite flight poses; no foot planted. These transition into frames5 and1 respectively.

headings.N: N directly BACK view facing UP/AWAY. Face invisible. Right weapon arm screen RIGHT. Keep back costume toward viewer.
headings.NE: NE back three-quarter facing UPPER RIGHT. Back coat and back of head visible, right weapon arm NEAR screen right.
headings.E: E exact RIGHT-facing SIDE PROFILE. Right weapon arm near camera, left arm far plain. LEGS MUST CHANGE OVERLAP: first figure NEAR right thigh bends backward with boot raised at screen LEFT, FAR left thigh stretches forward to screen RIGHT; second figure NEAR right thigh stretches to screen RIGHT, FAR left leg bends behind screen LEFT. Side silhouettes MUST exchange near and far leg placement. Device always stays on NEAR forearm in both figures.
headings.SE: SE front three-quarter facing LOWER RIGHT. Right weapon arm near camera on viewer LEFT, left arm plain.
headings.S: S directly FRONT facing DOWN toward viewer. Right weapon arm viewer LEFT, left arm viewer RIGHT plain.
headings.SW: SW front three-quarter facing LOWER LEFT. Face and nose toward screen LEFT. Right weapon arm far screen RIGHT, near left arm plain.
headings.W: W exact LEFT-facing SIDE PROFILE. Foreground LEFT arm plain leather glove; RIGHT weapon arm is FAR side partly hidden. Do not mirror an E pose.
headings.NW: NW back three-quarter facing UPPER LEFT. Back coat/head visible. Near LEFT arm plain; RIGHT weapon FAR side mostly hidden. No glow cloud.
